  •  Slightly increases stability

perks.name: Tactile String
perks.desc:
Stable, high-friction bowstring.
  •  Slightly increases accuracy
  •  Increases stability

perks.name: Elastic String
perks.desc:
Excellent snapback.
  •  Decreases accuracy
  •  Faster draw time
  •  Slightly increases handling speed

perks.name: Flexible String
perks.desc:
Light and easy to draw.
  •  Slightly faster draw time
  •  Slightly decreases accuracy
  •  Increases handling speed

perks.name: High Tension String
perks.desc:
Tightly strung bow.
  •  Greatly increases accuracy
  •  Slightly slower draw time
  •  Slightly decreases stability

perks.name: Natural String
perks.desc:
Simple balanced string.
  •  Slightly increases accuracy
  •  Slightly increases handling speed
  •  Slightly increases stability

perks.name: Polymer String
perks.desc:
Unbreakable bowstring.
  •  Slightly increases accuracy
  •  Slightly faster draw time

perks.name: Carbon Arrow Shaft
perks.desc:
Light and stable shaft material. 
  •  Increases stability

perks.name: Compact Arrow Shaft
perks.desc:
Thinner arrows to increase nocking speed and weapon handling.
  •  Increases handling speed 
  •  Increases reload speed

perks.name: Fiberglass Arrow Shaft
perks.desc:
Heavy and consistent. 
  •  Greatly increases accuracy
  •  Slightly decreases stability

perks.name: Helical Fletching
perks.desc:
Aerodynamic and light. 
  •  Slightly increases accuracy
  •  Slightly increases stability

perks.name: Natural Fletching
perks.desc:
Feather-light with good control.
  •  Slightly decreases accuracy
  •  Greatly increases stability

perks.name: Straight Fletching

perks.name: Perpetual Motion
perks.desc: This weapon gains bonus stability, handling, and reload speed while the wielder is in motion.

perks.name: Archer's Tempo
perks.desc: Draw time decreases after every precision hit.

perks.name: Perfect Float
perks.desc: Being in combat for a moderate time increases airborne effectiveness and reduces flinch until you are out of combat.

perks.name: Shoot to Loot
perks.desc: Shooting an Orb of Power picks it up. Shooting an ammo brick picks it up and automatically reloads all of your equipped weapons from reserves.

perks.name: Enlightened Action
perks.desc: Dealing damage improves reload speed and handling.

perks.name: Rangefinder
perks.desc: Aiming this weapon increases its effective range and zoom magnification. Increased projectile velocity while aiming Rocket Launchers, Grenade Launchers, and Bows.

perks.name: Firefly
perks.desc: Precision kills with this weapon increase reload speed and cause the target to explode, dealing Solar damage to nearby enemies.

perks.name: Successful Warm-Up
perks.desc: Each final blow increases charge/draw speed.

perks.name: Impulse Amplifier
perks.desc: Massively increases projectile velocity, increases reload speed.

perks.name: Rapid Hit
perks.desc: Rapid precision hits temporarily increase stability and reload speed.

perks.name: Incandescent
perks.desc:
Defeating a target spreads scorch to those nearby.
More powerful combatants and opposing Guardians cause scorch in a larger radius.

perks.name: Transcendent Moment
perks.desc: Final blows grant bonus stats based on the weapon's damage type alignment. Light elements grant stability and handling. Dark elements grant range and aim assist. While Transcendent, this weapon gets both bonuses.

perks.name: Attrition Orbs
perks.desc: Dealing sustained damage creates an Orb of Power.

perks.name: To the Pain
perks.desc:
While this weapon is equipped, taking damage increases handling and aim assist until the weapon is stowed.

Taking more damage increases the effect.

perks.name: Cornered
perks.desc: Faster charge time or draw time when surrounded by combatants.

perks.name: Opening Shot
perks.desc: Improved accuracy and range on the opening shot of attack.

perks.name: Incandescent
perks.desc:
Defeating a target spreads scorch to those nearby.
More powerful combatants and opposing Guardians cause scorch in a larger radius.

perks.name: Collective Action
perks.desc:
Collecting an Elemental pickup or destroying a Tangle grants this weapon a stacking period of increased damage. Throwing a Tangle provides additional time.

Elemental pickups include [Solar]Firesprites, [Void]Void Breaches, [Arc]Ionic Traces, [Stasis]Stasis Shards, and [Strand]Strand Tangles.

perks.name: Successful Warm-Up
perks.desc: Each final blow increases charge/draw speed.

perks.name: Opening Shot
perks.desc: Improved accuracy and range on the opening shot of attack.

perks.name: Explosive Head
perks.desc: Arrows explode after a short delay.

perks.name: Precision Instrument
perks.desc: Dealing sustained damage increases precision damage.

perks.name: Burning Ambition
perks.desc: Dealing sustained damage scorches the target. Dealing damage to a scorched target inflicts scorch.

perks.name: Binary Orbit
perks.desc: Elemental final blows opposite this weapon increase damage for a short duration. Darkness final blows boost Arc, Solar, and Void weapons. Light final blows boost Stasis, Strand, and Kinetic weapons.

perks.name: Elemental Honing
perks.desc: Dealing unique elemental damage grants this weapon a stacking damage bonus. This bonus is increased for kinetic weapons.

perks.name: Swashbuckler
perks.desc: This weapon gains increased damage from melee kills and kills with this weapon.

perks.name: High Ground
perks.desc: Final blows with this weapon grant stacks of bonus damage. Attacking targets from higher ground immediately grants the maximum number of stacks.

perks.name: Surrounded
perks.desc: This weapon gains bonus damage when three or more enemies are in close proximity.

perks.name: Archer's Gambit
perks.desc: Hipfire precision hits grant a massive draw-speed bonus for a short duration.

perks.name: Stunning Recovery
perks.desc: Stunning a Champion refills your magazine, triggers health regeneration, and improves recovery for a short duration.

perks.name: Vanguard's Vindication
perks.desc: Final blows with this weapon grant a small amount of health.

perks.name: Wild Card
perks.desc: Final blows with this weapon have a chance to create experimental submunitions at the target's location.

perks.name: Problem Solver
perks.desc:
Dealing sustained damage to Champion, miniboss, or boss combatants exhausts them and grants this weapon handling and reload speed.

Exhausted targets deal reduced outgoing damage.

perks.name: Vanguard Determination
perks.desc: After using your class ability, final blows with this weapon grant you bonus damage resistance.

notes: Inspired by @PodvsEnemies episode 151 from 26 August 2025 (https://open.spotify.com/episode/2i6uazTPn8rdPCD6amcjSc?si=C-kdbOCvTCqhRYq7M8zYnw) with @ImpetusAlways, @Saint_Kabr and @CourtProjects (PvE PvE-MinorSpec PvE-God PvE-EndGame M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE roll for use against minor adds in both general at-level or better, and end-game underleveled content, particularly with a Solar build. Pre Astyanax IV returns, reprised from Season 22 with refreshed perk set. At base, by comparison with its peers, the stats are okay, which is helped at Tier 4/5 when bowstring and arrow perks are enhanced - d2foundry.gg calculates that 33 Stability is ×1.0625 flinch resistance and a 0.40s perfect draw window, 50 Handling is 0.59s ready, 0.44s ADS and 0.45s stow speed, and 40 Reload Speed is a 0.78s reload. The standard play with bows is to use the bowstring perk to reduce Draw Time, and the arrow perk to improve Accuracy. There's no Archer's Tempo in the first trait perk slot, so the best alternative is Successful Warm-Up, which reduces Draw Time to ×0.625 for 6s after a kill, with additional kills extending the timer by 4s up to a maximum of 20s. However, you could also double down on solar perks to combine Incandescent, great for crowd control, spreading +30 Scorch stacks to adds within 4m on a Minor add kill (+45 stacks within 8m for orange and yellow bars), with Burning Ambition in the second. This procs a +10 scorch stack on tougher targets after 2 hits (1 when enhanced) with +10 added on each additional hit to build towards an ignition. All of the scorch stacks are increased by ×1.5 with Ember of Ashes. If you're interested, the literal translation means "Before Astyanax". Astyanax (“Lord of the City”), in Greek legend, is the Trojan popular nickname for the son of the city's greatest warrior, Prince Hector of Troy, and his wife Andromache. The Problem Solver Origin Trait is very good for PvE when facing orange and yellow bars - 3 arrows hitting will proc to exhaust them and reduce damage output to ×0.75 for 5s and grant +50 to Reload Speed and Handling for 10s. Otherwise, Wild Card is always fun, providing a chance to drop Telesto-like "experimental submunitions" on kills. Recommended MW: Draw Time, with your preferred choice of mod/enhanced mod to boost mag size, weapon stats, ammo regeneration, or elemental pickups for builds - and don't forget to check any available seasonal fragile mods.

pandapaxxy (PvP / M+KB / Controller): "Pre Astyanax IV loses Collective Action, Enlightened Action, Perfect Float, Perpetual Motion, and Rangefinder. In their place will be Archer’s Gambit, Attrition Orbs, Cornered, Surrounded and To the Pain." Recommended MW: Draw Time.

Inspired by @PodvsEnemies Podcast vs Enemies episode 77 (https://open.spotify.com/episode/4RxkTOwLINWvKzUitNoAFy?si=1426d1f760c544b5) with @ImpetusAlways and @Saint_Kabr while @CourtProjects is on holiday. First-choice PvE pick for add clear of Minor Spec enemies in end-game content. The literal translation means "Before Astyanax". Astyanax (“Lord of the City”), in Greek legend, is the Trojans' popular nickname for the son of the city's greatest warrior, Prince Hector of Troy, and his wife Andromache. If you haven't got a well-rolled solar Precision bow, this is your chance - the stats are poor, but there are still decent trait combos to chase. If you do, then you can happily pass this by. As ever with bows, we're looking to reduce the draw time with the bowstring, so Elastic String is the top choice, with Polymer String and Flexible String being decent alternate choices. Then, to recover the lost accuracy with the arrow perk, choose between Fiberglass Arrow Shaft or Straight Fletching. Archer's Tempo is the usual reliable choice as the support perk to speed up draw time, but you might also look at Shoot to Loot for picking up ammo bricks remotely in end-game content. In the second trait column as the signature perk, Explosive Head adds a passive boost to damage and adds flinch, and increases the radius for a Shoot to Loot ammo pickup. Recommended MW: Draw Time or Reload Speed, with a damage-boosting (Minor or Taken Spec) mod.

pandapaxxy (PvE / M+KB / Controller): "Next up is a very interesting and arguable best in slot bow. Pre Astyanax IV is a solar bow rivaling Tyranny of Heaven and Strident Whistle, but neither can slot in adept mods. Adept Big Ones plus Precision Instrument will be an incredible combination. Incandescent for clearing rooms is another strong choice but I'm leaning towards Precision Instrument as the best in slot." Recommened MW: Draw Time.

pandapaxxy (PvP / Controller): "Pre Astyanax IV is not really meant for the crucible but you can achieve some really great stats through adept mods. Either lowering the draw time further or increasing the accuracy. Archer's Tempo is the best in slot, but you can pair that with a bunch of other perks like Opening Shot, Explosive Head, or even Successful Warm-Up for even faster follow up shots after a kill." Recommended MW: Draw Time.
